card.name: Handling restrictions in preparation steps
card.fires_on: The word 'without' (and similar spots like 'Do not') right after a preparation or administration step in injection and infusion instructions, where a restriction on how to handle the product follows. Also fires on a few odd spots inside brand names or units in infusion text.

modes.label: 'Without' after a step
modes.description: 'without' follows an instruction to warm, mix or give a product, introducing a handling restriction.
modes.example: remove COSENTYX from the refrigerator and allow it to reach room temperature<< without>> removing the needle cap.

modes.label: Inside infusion terms
modes.description: Partway through a brand name, unit or dilution term in infusion instructions.
modes.example: The rate of infusion of IN<<MA>>ZEB may be slowed or

modes.label: The 'do not' wording
modes.description: 'not' in a short 'Do not shake' command after reconstitution.
modes.example: Swirl the vial gently until completely dissolved. Do<< not>> shake.

card.plain: It responds to the point in preparation or administration steps where the text says what is not to be done, such as 'without shaking' or 'without removing the cap'.
